items.headline: $MIM to Wind Down at 4 Cents on the Dollar
items.summary: Abracadabra proposes liquidating the protocol and paying $MIM holders pro rata, with just $900K recoverable against $21M of bad debt.

items.headline: $BAL Holders Vote to Wind Down Balancer
items.summary: Balancer token holders approved winding down the protocol and rejected an official fork, marking the end of a DeFi OG.

items.headline: First US Spot $NEAR ETF Launches After 3x Rally
items.summary: Bitwise debuted the first US spot $NEAR ETF after the token nearly tripled since August, riding the Intents volume boom.

items.headline: $AZTEC Relaunches zk.money Privacy Wallet on L2
items.summary: Aztec brought back its zk.money privacy wallet on its Ethereum Layer 2, reviving private onchain payments.

items.headline: $GOMINTLY Debuts Self-Custodial RWA Aggregator
items.summary: GoMintly launched a self-custodial aggregator for tokenized assets, a fresh new DeFi use case in the RWA boom.
